verdict.rationale: Zep's governance docs say ABAC policies attach to API keys, and these policies limit which actions and context each agent can reach. The docs explicitly frame this as least-privilege access for agents, so the product directly provides scoped credentials for agents. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how keys are issued and scoped (policy syntax, per-key scope granularity, expiry/rotation), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Limit which actions and context each agent and Memory MCP user can reach with ABAC policies attached to API keys and UserGroups.
Use policies when you need least-privilege access to context for agents and Memory MCP users.
Attribute-based access control governs API keys and UserGroups.
